items: We make jiaozi every Lunar New Year for good luck.
每年春节我们家包饺子，讨个吉利。
Wonton soup is a light and comforting breakfast on cold mornings.
寒冷的早晨来一碗馄饨汤，清淡又暖胃。
Crispy spring rolls with sweet chili sauce are a must at Chinese New Year.
过年餐桌上少不了酥脆的春卷，蘸甜辣酱吃。
We eat mooncakes while admiring the full moon on Mid-Autumn Festival.
中秋节我们边赏月边吃月饼。
Zongzi are wrapped in bamboo leaves and steamed or boiled for hours.
粽子用粽叶包好，蒸或煮上几个小时。
Sweet and sour spare ribs are a hit at any family dinner.
糖醋排骨是家宴上的抢手菜。
Yuxiang shredded pork has a name meaning 'fish-fragrant' but contains no fish.
鱼香肉丝名字里虽有「鱼香」二字，其实没有鱼。
sautéed shredded pork in sweet bean sauce
Jingjiang rousi wraps shredded pork in tofu skin with sweet bean paste.
京酱肉丝用豆皮卷着甜面酱炒的肉丝吃。
Dan dan noodles are served in a small bowl with a heavy chili oil topping.
担担面用小碗装，面上浇厚厚一层红辣油。
Hot and sour sweet potato noodles are a famous street food in Chongqing.
酸辣粉是重庆著名的街头小吃，酸辣开胃。
Malatang lets you pick your own skewers cooked in spicy broth.
麻辣烫自己选菜串，浸入麻辣汤里烫熟。
Grilled fish arrives at the table sizzling in a sea of chili and bean sprouts.
烤鱼端上桌时还在滋滋作响，泡在辣椒和豆芽里。
Steamed sea bass is simple to prepare but shows the chef's skill.
清蒸鲈鱼做法简单，最见厨师功力。
Garlic stir-fried choy sum is a classic Cantonese side dish.
蒜蓉炒菜心是经典粤式配菜。
Dry-pot cauliflower is smoky, spicy and a favorite at Sichuan restaurants.
干锅花菜干香微辣，是川菜馆的招牌。
Hand-torn cabbage is wok-tossed with chilies and vinegar for a tangy crunch.
手撕包菜用辣椒和醋大火爆炒，酸爽脆嫩。
Hot and sour soup wakes up your appetite with its bold flavors.
酸辣汤味道浓郁，特别开胃。
Egg drop soup is the simplest comfort food in any Chinese home.
蛋花汤是家家户户最简单的家常汤。
Century egg and pork congee is the king of Cantonese breakfasts.
皮蛋瘦肉粥是粤式早餐之王。
A bowl of plain congee with pickles is a soothing sick-day meal.
一碗白粥配小菜，是生病时最舒服的病号饭。
Youtiao is best enjoyed dunked in hot soy milk or paired with congee.
油条最好蘸着热豆浆或配粥一起吃。
Sweet or savory soy milk is the classic companion to youtiao at breakfast.
甜豆浆或咸豆浆都是油条的最佳早餐搭档。
Tofu pudding can be served sweet with syrup or savory with chili and pickles.
豆腐脑可甜吃（加糖水）也可咸吃（加辣椒、榨菜）。
Tea eggs simmer in soy sauce and spices, marbling the whites with brown veins.
茶叶蛋用酱油和香料慢煮，蛋白上出现褐色花纹。
Bubble tea with chewy tapioca pearls originated in Taiwan in the 1980s.
珍珠奶茶里的 Q 弹珍珠诞生于 1980 年代的台湾。
Mango pomelo sago is a chilled Hong Kong dessert of mango, pomelo and sago pearls.
杨枝甘露是港式甜品，由芒果、西柚和西米露制成。
Pineapple cake is the most popular souvenir from Taiwan.
凤梨酥是台湾最受欢迎的伴手礼。
Sizzling beef plate arrives still bubbling on a hot iron skillet.
铁板牛肉端上桌时还在铁板上滋滋冒泡。
Candied sweet potatoes pull out long sugar threads when broken apart.
拔丝地瓜夹起时能拉出长长的糖丝。
Sour plum drink is the traditional Beijing summer cooler.
酸梅汤是老北京传统的消暑饮料。
